name: io.github.katara-ai-inc/katara
title: Katara
description: Katara's managed MCP server for connecting AI agents and IDEs to the Katara AI data management platform.

tools.name: ingest_data_source
tools.description: Connect and ingest data from external sources such as files, websites, GitHub, Notion, Google Drive, APIs, and databases into Katara.

tools.name: configure_rag_pipeline
tools.description: Configure Katara-managed retrieval pipelines, including chunking, embeddings, vector storage, and indexing settings.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search and retrieve context from data that has been indexed in Katara for agent and application workflows.

tools.name: scan_compliance
tools.description: Scan data and configurations for compliance and sensitive-data issues such as PII, PCI, health data, and EU regulatory concerns.

tools.name: optimize_ai_backend
tools.description: Review and improve backend performance characteristics such as latency, token usage, caching, and overall AI operating cost.
